requirements: Use actual shared reviewed-batch consumer/HTTPAdapter for remote fixtures.
Preview and validation must not resolve a credential or perform HTTP.
All reads have one attempt, a finite output leaf projection and 4MiB response bound.
Synthetic fixtures do not qualify vendor entitlement, grants, refresh/restart/disconnect or full ChatGPT parity.
